dimension_evidence.diagnosis: Correct diagnosis must connect schema-name ordering to bound-method receiver injection during graph-module source generation, then establish that the same parameter list feeds both the callable signature and positional flattening bindings. It must also recognize that a neighboring candidate name can already be occupied.
dimension_evidence.localization: The public Prompt reports a syntax failure for a subset of valid overload schemas but exposes no source path, generator class, method, reserved identifier, generated signature, rename pattern, or binding helper. The solver must locate the functional graph-capture code path and distinguish it from eager dispatch and unrelated native error propagation.
dimension_evidence.repair_regression: The repair requires a non-mutating, collision-free normalization of only problematic nonleading names and must feed the identical normalized list to signature generation and body binding. The oracle covers a real overload end to end, an additional neighboring-name collision, and a conventional receiver-first schema control.
